---
title: "Where should I start?"
---

The HMT archive is large and complex. Rather than try to produce a comprehensive HMT app, my approach is to experiment with numerous small, focused apps. Here are some ideas about how you might start exploring the HMT archive.

## Major components of the archive

The HMT archive includes (among other things):

- collections of digital images of Homeric manuscripts
- cataloged data about manuscripts of the *Iliad*
- editions of texts of the *Iliad* and *scholia*
- indexes associating texts, manuscript pages, and images
- other indexes including proper nouns and adjectives
